title: Supreme renamed the Nola band; instrumentation
summary: The Supreme broke up and became the Nola band under Lacasse after Jackson was pushed out; one trumpet, no piano or sax at first, two trumpets only around 1929-30.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
